name: Antarctica Station B
description: A research station on a broad white ice shelf with a red-roofed main base on the right, orange cabins along a snow track, a wooden dock on a dark sea bay at left, penguins and seals up front, and snow-dusted hills and icebergs behind.
author: Claude
prompt:
An Antarctic research station on broad white ice shelves, with a red-roofed main base as the landmark, small orange cabins, radio masts, a short wooden dock, snow-dusted rocky hills, and groups of low-poly penguins and a few seals in the foreground, with icebergs floating in the dark sea behind. (for the film: What if Antarctica melted completely?)
Variation: a different layout from the obvious one (landmark on the other side, a different street or shoreline pattern).
